fullText.simplified:
曹操对董卓

    曹操看到董卓和吕布跑了，就对元少说：“现在是杀董卓的好机会！我们快带军队去打他们吧！”
    元少不想马上去打董卓。“我们刚刚进城，有很多事情要做。我是大将军，我要在城里。”
    曹操很生气，他又问别的将军：“谁愿意跟我一起去打董卓？”
    没有人回答他。
    这些将军们都不想让自己的军队去打董卓。不是他们不敢打，是因为大家都不希望让自己的军队去。大家都在等别人去打董卓，因为别人军队的人被杀了，自己就比别人军队的人多了。
    曹操很不高兴，他看到没有人愿意去打董卓，就自己带他的军队去了。没想到，董卓虽然跑了，但是他的军队还有很多人。曹操军队的人比董卓的少，打不过董卓。后来，他的军队很多人被杀了，只有五百人了。
    曹操回到城里以后，很生气地对那些将军们说：“吕布跑了，董卓跑了，那么好的机会，刚才如果我们一起去打董卓，就一定能杀了他。可是你们，你们在干什么？你们都只想着自己，都不愿意去打董卓，那么好的机会就这么没了！”
    “还有你！”曹操看着元少，越想越生气。“你是大将军，大家都听你的。你不带大家去打董卓，在城里干什么？这次没能杀董卓，都是你的错！”
    元少知道曹操说的话是对的，所以只能不说话了。
    曹操觉得元少不是一个能做大事的人，所以他决定带他的五百人军队离开。别的将军看到没有杀董卓的好机会了，也都离开了。
fullText.traditional:
曹操對董卓

    曹操看到董卓和呂布跑了，就對元少說：“現在是殺董卓的好機會！我們快帶軍隊去打他們吧！”
    元少不想馬上去打董卓。“我們剛剛進城，有很多事情要做。我是大將軍，我要在城裡。”
    曹操很生氣，他又問別的將軍：“誰願意跟我一起去打董卓？”
    沒有人回答他。
    這些將軍們都不想讓自己的軍隊去打董卓。不是他們不敢打，是因為大家都不希望讓自己的軍隊去。大家都在等別人去打董卓，因為別人軍隊的人被殺了，自己就比別人軍隊的人多了。
    曹操很不高興，他看到沒有人願意去打董卓，就自己帶他的軍隊去了。沒想到，董卓雖然跑了，但是他的軍隊還有很多人。曹操軍隊的人比董卓的少，打不過董卓。後來，他的軍隊很多人被殺了，只有五百人了。
    曹操回到城裡以後，很生氣地對那些將軍們說：“呂布跑了，董卓跑了，那麼好的機會，剛才如果我們一起去打董卓，就一定能殺了他。可是你們，你們在幹什麼？你們都只想著自己，都不願意去打董卓，那麼好的機會就這麼沒了！”
    “還有你！”曹操看著元少，越想越生氣。“你是大將軍，大家都聽你的。你不帶大家去打董卓，在城裡幹什麼？這次沒能殺董卓，都是你的錯！”
    元少知道曹操說的話是對的，所以只能不說話了。
    曹操覺得元少不是一個能做大事的人，所以他決定帶他的五百人軍隊離開。別的將軍看到沒有殺董卓的好機會了，也都離開了。

sentences.simplified: “现在是杀董卓的好机会！我们快带军队去打他们吧！”
sentences.traditional: “現在是殺董卓的好機會！我們快帶軍隊去打他們吧！”
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài shì shā dǒng zhuó de hǎo jī huì wǒ men kuài dài jūn duì qù dǎ tā men ba
sentences.english: .. “Now is a great opportunity to kill Dong Zhuo! Let’s quickly take our troops to fight them!”

sentences.simplified: 元少不想马上去打董卓。
sentences.traditional: 元少不想馬上去打董卓。
sentences.pinyin: yuán shào bù xiǎng mǎ shàng qù dǎ dǒng zhuó
sentences.english: Yuan Shao did not want to go fight Dong Zhuo immediately.

sentences.simplified: “我们刚刚进城，有很多事情要做。
sentences.traditional: “我們剛剛進城，有很多事情要做。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ men gāng gang jìn chéng yǒu hěn duō shì qing yào zuò
sentences.english: “We just arrived in the city, and there are a lot of things that need to be done.

sentences.simplified: 我是大将军，我要在城里。”
sentences.traditional: 我是大將軍，我要在城裡。”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ shì dà jiāng jūn wǒ yào zài chéng lǐ
sentences.english: I’m the generalissimo, and I will stay in the city.”

sentences.simplified: 曹操很生气，他又问别的将军：“谁愿意跟我一起去打董卓？”
sentences.traditional: 曹操很生氣，他又問別的將軍：“誰願意跟我一起去打董卓？”
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo hěn shēng qì tā yòu wèn bié de jiāng jūn shéi yuàn yì gēn wǒ yì qǐ qù dǎ dǒng zhuó
sentences.english: Cao Cao was very angry. He then asked the other generals, “Who is willing to go fight Dong Zhuo with me?”

sentences.simplified: 没有人回答他。
sentences.traditional: 沒有人回答他。
sentences.pinyin: méi yǒu rén huí dá tā
sentences.english: No one answered him.

sentences.simplified: 这些将军们都不想让自己的军队去打董卓。
sentences.traditional: 這些將軍們都不想讓自己的軍隊去打董卓。
sentences.pinyin: zhè xiē jiāng jūn men dōu bù xiǎng ràng zì jǐ de jūn duì qù dǎ dǒng zhuó
sentences.english: None of the generals wanted their troops to go fight Dong Zhuo.

sentences.simplified: 不是他们不敢打，是因为大家都不希望让自己的军队去。
sentences.traditional: 不是他們不敢打，是因為大家都不希望讓自己的軍隊去。
sentences.pinyin: bú shì tā men bù gǎn dǎ shì yīn wèi dà jiā dōu bù xī wàng ràng zì jǐ de jūn duì qù
sentences.english: It wasn’t that they did not dare to fight; rather, it was because no one wanted their own troops to go.

sentences.simplified: 大家都在等别人去打董卓，
sentences.traditional: 大家都在等別人去打董卓，
sentences.pinyin: dà jiā dōu zài děng bié ren qù dǎ dǒng zhuó
sentences.english: Everyone was waiting for someone else to go fight Dong Zhuo.

sentences.simplified: 因为别人军队的人被杀了，自己就比别人军队的人多了。
sentences.traditional: 因為別人軍隊的人被殺了，自己就比別人軍隊的人多了。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi bié ren jūn duì de rén bèi shā le zì jǐ jiù bǐ bié ren jūn duì de rén duō le
sentences.english: Because, if the troops of the other generals were killed, then they would have more troops than the other generals.

sentences.simplified: 曹操很不高兴，
sentences.traditional: 曹操很不高興，
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo hěn bù gāo xìng
sentences.english: Cao Cao was very unhappy.

sentences.simplified: 他看到没有人愿意去打董卓，就自己带他的军队去了。
sentences.traditional: 他看到沒有人願意去打董卓，就自己帶他的軍隊去了。
sentences.pinyin: tā kàn dào méi yǒu rén yuàn yì qù dǎ dǒng zhuó jiù zì jǐ dài tā de jūn duì qù le
sentences.english: He saw that no one was willing to go fight Dong Zhuo, so he took his own troops to go fight.

sentences.simplified: 没想到，董卓虽然跑了，但是他的军队还有很多人。
sentences.traditional: 沒想到，董卓雖然跑了，但是他的軍隊還有很多人。
sentences.pinyin: méi xiǎng dào dǒng zhuó suī rán pǎo le dàn shì tā de jūn duì hái yǒu hěn duō rén
sentences.english: No one expected that although Dong Zhuo escaped, he still had many troops.

sentences.simplified: 曹操军队的人比董卓的少，打不过董卓。
sentences.traditional: 曹操軍隊的人比董卓的少，打不過董卓。
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo jūn duì de rén bǐ dǒng zhuó de shǎo dǎ bú guò dǒng zhuó
sentences.english: Cao Cao had fewer troops than Dong Zhuo and was unable to defeat Dong Zhuo.

sentences.simplified: 后来，他的军队很多人被杀了，只有五百人了。
sentences.traditional: 後來，他的軍隊很多人被殺了，只有五百人了。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái tā de jūn duì hěn duō rén bèi shā le zhǐ yǒu wǔ bǎi rén le
sentences.english: In the end, many of his troops were killed, and he only had five hundred left.

sentences.simplified: 曹操回到城里以后，很生气地对那些将军们说：
sentences.traditional: 曹操回到城裡以後，很生氣地對那些將軍們說：
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo huí dào chéng lǐ yǐ hòu hěn shēng qì de duì nà xiē jiāng jūn men shuō
sentences.english: After Cao Cao returned to the city, he said to the other generals angrily, ..

sentences.simplified: “吕布跑了，董卓跑了，那么好的机会，
sentences.traditional: “呂布跑了，董卓跑了，那麼好的機會，
sentences.pinyin: lǚ bù pǎo le dǒng zhuó pǎo le nà me hǎo de jī huì
sentences.english: .. “Lü Bu has escaped, Dong Zhuo has escaped. It was such a good opportunity.

sentences.simplified: 刚才如果我们一起去打董卓，就一定能杀了他。
sentences.traditional: 剛才如果我們一起去打董卓，就一定能殺了他。
sentences.pinyin: gāng cái rú guǒ wǒ men yì qǐ qù dǎ dǒng zhuó jiù yí dìng néng shā le tā
sentences.english: If we had gone to fight Dong Zhuo together just now, we would have definitely been able to kill him.

sentences.simplified: 可是你们，你们在干什么？你们都只想着自己，都不愿意去打董卓，
sentences.traditional: 可是你們，你們在幹什麼？你們都只想著自己，都不願意去打董卓，
sentences.pinyin: kě shì nǐ men nǐ men zài gàn shén me nǐ men dōu zhǐ xiǎng zhe zì jǐ dōu bú yuàn yì qù dǎ dǒng zhuó
sentences.english: But you, what were you doing? You were only thinking of yourselves. No one was willing to go fight Dong Zhuo.

sentences.simplified: 那么好的机会就这么没了！”
sentences.traditional: 那麼好的機會就這麼沒了！”
sentences.pinyin: nà me hǎo de jī huì jiù zhè me méi le
sentences.english: Such a good opportunity is gone just like that!”

sentences.simplified: “还有你！”曹操看着元少，越想越生气。
sentences.traditional: “還有你！”曹操看著元少，越想越生氣。
sentences.pinyin: hái yǒu nǐ cáo cāo kàn zhe yuán shào yuè xiǎng yuè shēng qì
sentences.english: “And you, too!” Cao Cao was looking at Yuan Shao. The more he thought about it, the angrier he became.

sentences.simplified: “你是大将军，大家都听你的。
sentences.traditional: “你是大將軍，大家都聽你的。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ shì dà jiāng jūn dà jiā dōu tīng nǐ de
sentences.english: “You are the generalissimo, and everyone listens to you.

sentences.simplified: 你不带大家去打董卓，在城里干什么？
sentences.traditional: 你不帶大家去打董卓，在城裡幹什麼？
sentences.pinyin: nǐ bú dài dà jiā qù dǎ dǒng zhuó zài chéng lǐ gàn shén me
sentences.english: You didn’t lead everyone to fight Dong Zhuo. What were you doing in the city?

sentences.simplified: 这次没能杀董卓，都是你的错！”
sentences.traditional: 這次沒能殺董卓，都是你的錯！”
sentences.pinyin: zhè cì méi néng shā dǒng zhuó dōu shì nǐ de cuò
sentences.english: The fact that we were unable to kill Dong Zhuo this time is all your fault!”

sentences.simplified: 元少知道曹操说的话是对的，所以只能不说话了。
sentences.traditional: 元少知道曹操說的話是對的，所以只能不說話了。
sentences.pinyin: yuán shào zhī dào cáo cāo shuō de huà shì duì de suǒ yǐ zhǐ néng bù shuō huà le
sentences.english: Yuan Shao knew that what Cao Cao said was right, so he could only remain silent.

sentences.simplified: 曹操觉得元少不是一个能做大事的人，
sentences.traditional: 曹操覺得元少不是一個能做大事的人，
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo jué de yuán shào bú shì yí ge néng zuò dà shì de rén
sentences.english: Cao Cao believed that Yuan Shao was not someone who could accomplish great things, ..

sentences.simplified: 所以他决定带他的五百人军队离开。
sentences.traditional: 所以他決定帶他的五百人軍隊離開。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ tā jué dìng dài tā de wǔ bǎi rén jūn duì lí kāi
sentences.english: .. so he decided to take his five hundred troops and leave.

sentences.simplified: 别的将军看到没有杀董卓的好机会了，也都离开了。
sentences.traditional: 別的將軍看到沒有殺董卓的好機會了，也都離開了。
sentences.pinyin: bié de jiāng jūn kàn dào méi yǒu shā dǒng zhuó de hǎo jī huì le yě dōu lí kāi le
sentences.english: The other generals saw that there was no longer a good opportunity to kill Dong Zhuo, and all left as well.

sentence_translations: Cao Cao vs. Dong Zhuo
Cao Cao saw that Dong Zhuo and Lü Bu escaped, and said to Yuan Shao, ..
.. “Now is a great opportunity to kill Dong Zhuo! Let’s quickly take our troops to fight them!”
Yuan Shao did not want to go fight Dong Zhuo immediately.
“We just arrived in the city, and there are a lot of things that need to be done.
I’m the generalissimo, and I will stay in the city.”
Cao Cao was very angry. He then asked the other generals, “Who is willing to go fight Dong Zhuo with me?”
No one answered him.
None of the generals wanted their troops to go fight Dong Zhuo.
It wasn’t that they did not dare to fight; rather, it was because no one wanted their own troops to go.
Everyone was waiting for someone else to go fight Dong Zhuo.
Because, if the troops of the other generals were killed, then they would have more troops than the other generals.
Cao Cao was very unhappy.
He saw that no one was willing to go fight Dong Zhuo, so he took his own troops to go fight.
No one expected that although Dong Zhuo escaped, he still had many troops.
Cao Cao had fewer troops than Dong Zhuo and was unable to defeat Dong Zhuo.
In the end, many of his troops were killed, and he only had five hundred left.
After Cao Cao returned to the city, he said to the other generals angrily, ..
.. “Lü Bu has escaped, Dong Zhuo has escaped. It was such a good opportunity.
If we had gone to fight Dong Zhuo together just now, we would have definitely been able to kill him.
But you, what were you doing? You were only thinking of yourselves. No one was willing to go fight Dong Zhuo.
Such a good opportunity is gone just like that!”
“And you, too!” Cao Cao was looking at Yuan Shao. The more he thought about it, the angrier he became.
“You are the generalissimo, and everyone listens to you.
You didn’t lead everyone to fight Dong Zhuo. What were you doing in the city?
The fact that we were unable to kill Dong Zhuo this time is all your fault!”
Yuan Shao knew that what Cao Cao said was right, so he could only remain silent.
Cao Cao believed that Yuan Shao was not someone who could accomplish great things, ..
.. so he decided to take his five hundred troops and leave.
The other generals saw that there was no longer a good opportunity to kill Dong Zhuo, and all left as well.
